note: Ch.5 names the particular profound boredom as the fundamental attunement of OUR contemporary Dasein — not boredom in general.
The reconsidered guiding question concerns whether the Da-sein in contemporary man is bored as such, not whether people are bored by particular things.
Profound boredom 'only becomes awake if we do not counteract it'; not-counteracting = Dasein's keeping-to-itself, a waiting.
Against programmaticism: a question (not only an answer) can provide a hold; essential knowledge only in originary questioning.
Being-left-empty = being delivered over to beings' telling refusal of themselves as a whole; an emptiness as a whole.
Emptiness 'in the sense of telling refusal … thus emptiness as lack, deprivation, need [Not]'.
Contemporary self-defense against particular needs precisely prevents any need 'as a whole' from emerging — so particular needs are no proof of emptiness as a whole.
Keystone diagnosis: the very absence of any essential oppressiveness IS the emptiness as a whole; 'the fundamental emptiness that bores us'.
Bedrängnis glossed against bedrängt; the need is not that this/that need oppresses but that essential oppressiveness is absent.
The mystery [Geheimnis] is lacking, so the inner terror that gives Dasein its greatness remains absent.
Absence of oppressiveness attested by restless busyness: a universal smug contentment in not being endangered; learned competencies cannot replace strength.
Being-held-in-limbo = being impelled toward the extremity of what makes Dasein possible — the moment of vision (Augenblick), simultaneously announced.
Commensurate with emptiness as a whole, the demand pure and simple: that Dasein as such is demanded of man — 'given to him — to be there'.
Moment of vision to be seized as the innermost necessity of the freedom of Dasein; man must resolutely open himself again to this demand.
Contemporary haste/abruptness of programs is confused with resolute disclosedness yet keeps the moment of vision blunt.
Liberating the Dasein in man = loading Dasein upon him as his ownmost burden; only those who can give themselves a burden are free.
The oscillation between expanse of emptiness and extremity of the moment of vision cannot be ascertained as a matter of fact — 'we can only ask'.
Contemporary man may conceal his Dasein from himself precisely through psychology, which today presents itself as depth psychology.
